d.ko:
Can you find love at the nerdiest convention ever? 
"Monster Con" goes back to the multiplayer dating sim formula: go through absurd and funny situations as you find love among six sexy monsters!
Who will you romance? The mimic who cosplays? The idol clown? Or the eldritch cutie? (There's also Liam)

rv.t: 원작에 비해 야시꾸리함 수치가 폭파적임 (만족) 영어좀 할수있다=무조건 만족 요즘엔 잘 없는 갤러리 기능도 캐릭터, npc, 표정등등 다 볼수있게 되있어서 이쁜 그림 감상도 가능 원작은 반반확률이라는 선택지가 부담스러운대 그에비해 몬스터콘은 어떤 선택지를 골라도 호감도가 깎이는 일이 …
Wonderful game, would recommend to anyone who has enjoyed others from the franchise. I would also consider it one of the most strong as far as gameplay mechanics go. …

As a major Liam de Lioncourt fan since the first game this game is a love letter personalized to ME! (PARTIAL) joke aside the humor is very good and the writing while already charming before I feel like shines the best in this game. …

If you did not like or were just apathetic towards liam avoid this one. This game is largely revolved around him to a frustrating degree and it will just get on your nerves if you don't like him already.
这一代有特别萌的开场动画，仍旧惊人的剧情文本量和事件数量，还有各种二次元文化藏在剧情里。在刷boldness属性值时看到每个pc穿着各种角色的cos服并认出ip太好玩了，milo你竟然素隔壁那个热度烫得要命的白毛吸血鬼（震惊）。 …
比前几作选项更灵活，形式更有趣。小漫画这种创新老有意思了，可惜没有中文啊啊啊啊啊。
